articles.title: Not Kohli, Rohit Or Gill: Mitchell Santner Reveals Which Indian He Hates Facing The Most
articles.description: India will begin their five-match ODI assignment against New Zealand on Wednesday, looking to carry the momentum from their 3-2 victory in the preceding T20I series. With Rohit Sharma and Virat Kohli back in the spotlight and Shubman Gill entrusted with captaincy, the opening encounter promises plenty of talking points. Before the action gets underway, Gill and his New Zealand counterpart, Mitchell Santner shared a light-hearted moment during a quick-fire interaction. One of the questions put to both captains was about an opposition player they would least enjoy facing. Santner Hates Facing Arshdeep The Most When asked which Indian cricketer does Mithcell Santner hated facing the most, fans would have either guessed Rohit Sharma or Virat Kohli or even Shubman Gill. However, the Kiwi all-rounder revealed that this player was fast bowler Arshdeep Singh. Shubman Gill was asked the same question, and his answer was his New Zealand counterpart. Spotlight Back On Rohit-Kohli Much of the attention surrounding India's ODI series will naturally centre on Rohit Sharma and Virat Kohli. The two senior batsmen remain major attractions as they take the field on another tour of the Southern Hemisphere. Their presence, however, is only one part of the series narrative. India's bowling resources could prove a significant talking point, particularly with the team heading into the contest without its first-choice combination. India's Poor New Zealand Record India and New Zealand have met 123 times in men's ODIs, with India holding the overall edge with 63 wins against the Black Caps' 52. Seven matches ended without a result, while one was tied. However, India's record takes a hit when the contests are played in New Zealand. Of the 45 ODIs played on Kiwi soil, India have won just 14, while the hosts have claimed 26 victories. One match ended in a tie, and four had no result.
